name: Moon Environment Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Moon Environment Technology Co., Ltd., established in 1956 and headquartered in Yantai, China, is a global manufacturer and distributor of advanced air-conditioning and refrigeration systems. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of temperature control solutions. Its refrigeration offerings include various compressors (refrigeration and marine), condensing units, and different types of chillers such as water-cooled and brine units. Auxiliary refrigeration components like evaporative condensers and A2 refrigerated tanks are also produced, alongside industrial air coolers. For cold storage applications, the company supplies insulated panels made from EPS, metal corrugated, and polyurethane sandwich materials, as well as machinery for producing flake and block ice. In the air conditioning segment, Moon Environment Technology provides water-cooled centrifugal and screw chillers, screw compressor water source heat pumps, modular air handling units, air-cooled screw heat pumps, and fan coil units. Additionally, the firm manufactures specialized equipment for food processing, including quick-freezing devices, industrial dryer machines, vacuum fryer lines, and fresh food processing systems. Gas compression needs are addressed with screw air compressors and process gas compressor package units. Beyond manufacturing, the company delivers a comprehensive range of services. These span the entire project lifecycle for industrial and commercial refrigeration and environmental air conditioning systems. Services include initial project planning, engineering design, equipment selection, logistics, and transportation, through to installation and commissioning. Post-implementation support features equipment maintenance, technical training, ongoing follow-up services, and system improvement and upgrading. Furthermore, the company provides dedicated services for its overseas sales department, general sales support, and spare parts. The company underwent a name change from its former identity, Yantai Moon Co., Ltd., adopting Moon Environment Technology Co., Ltd. in September 2017.
